title: An asset with no year, make or model is labeled with the VIN on its own
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission; ability to edit assets for seeding.
preconditions: 1. A ZZAUTOTEST asset exists with a VIN but no year, make, or model, and has an invoice in range.
steps: 1. Expand the owning customer and read that asset row's label.
expected: 1. The label is the VIN on its own (no year/make/model base, no "VIN …" suffix form).
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: Video P24 (user ruling 2026-07-28: video overrides spec (video newer, last-update-wins)): the asset identifier is now the SERIAL NUMBER. This case's no-year/make/model rule (S8-R9: label = the VIN on its own) is not itself overridden by the video, but re-confirm the fallback in the build once the serial-number identifier ships.
